name: ak-shopping-markets
description: Myanmar retail, wholesale, inventory and shopping center management app

scripts.copy-web: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');fs.mkdirSync('www',{recursive:true});const files=[['v2/index.html','index.html'],['firebase-config.js','firebase-config.js'],['v2/manifest.webmanifest','manifest.webmanifest'],['v2/sw.js','sw.js'],['v2/icon.svg','icon.svg']];for(const [src,dst] of files){if(!fs.existsSync(src))throw new Error('Missing '+src);fs.copyFileSync(src,path.join('www',dst));}if(fs.existsSync('app.html'))fs.copyFileSync('app.html',path.join('www','marketplace.html'));" && node scripts/copy-zxing.js
scripts.android:sync: npm run copy-web && cap sync android
